verses.text: In Darius’s second year, on the first day of the sixth month, the LORD gave this message through Haggai the prophet to Judah’s governor Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest:
“The LORD of Armies says this: These people keep saying, ‘The time hasn’t come to rebuild the LORD’s house.’”
Then the LORD sent another message through Haggai:
“Is it really time for you to live in finished, paneled houses while my house lies in ruins?
So this is what the LORD of Armies says: “Take a good look at how you’re living.

“You plant a lot but harvest little. You eat, but you’re still hungry; you drink, but you’re still thirsty. You put on clothes, but you’re not warm. And the worker’s pay disappears like money dropped into a bag full of holes.”
The LORD of Armies says again: “Take a good look at how you’re living.
“Go up into the hills, bring back timber, and rebuild my house. Then I’ll be pleased with it and honored,” says the LORD.

“You expected a big harvest, but it came up short. When you brought it home, I scattered it. Why? My house is still in ruins while each of you rushes to take care of your own house,” says the LORD of Armies.
“That’s why the sky has held back its dew and the ground its crops.
“I called for drought on the land and hills, on the grain, new wine, and olive oil, on everything the soil produces, on people and animals, and on all the work people do.”

Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest, and all the people who remained listened to the LORD their God and to Haggai’s words. The LORD their God had sent him, and the people stood in awe of the LORD.
Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, delivered this message from the LORD: “I am with you,” says the LORD.

The LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel, Judah’s governor, and the spirit of Joshua the high priest, along with the spirit of all the people who remained. They came and began working on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God.
This happened on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in Darius’s second year.
